book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Iesu la amumuriraong non migana na kin o burunam Betsaida
Non tara malonim o non la o sabat o lotu maiong Israel la betieng. Are ratmat ga inagat ula Iesu Ierusalem.

Tapma na taun Ierusalem ame non kin o burunam la iot kagarat ai tabuna maiang sipsipup. Tie, o ties Ebaraio inamaniap la meivo uriro kin, Betsaida, na taralap o uriro burunam ame 5 ma parandap mila kakanim la maiot.
Pa na miriro parandap, papot teip mila tafameng la maionama ga teip mila sapsapmeng ga kibap mila kiram ga teip mila malubemeng mualap ma. Ouanmela uriro burunam leba alagaieng.
[Ma non tarap non angelo la ume uobu me tatang na uriro kin ga ume obukbugira kin. Terugusieng ara kin, tie man migana la lake ula tatang na kin, eba ina mumuri ba, tie leba amaning man tafa.]
Non migana la unama bo labun la tafaong puoieng ira ma 38 ma karaip.
Agimaong Iesu iriro migana la man unama ga ait, tafaong ara a tara ila laklage. Are ratmat ga amarikong Iesu, “Atabo nanung le ina mumurum ba neip nuo?”

Migana ila tafaong la upulo ties ang ga ugama, “Migana ila kakani, tara la terugusieng kin, tale kan mating migana meba tolagiang ga toabung tapma na kin. Turuo kan la tuga tala, pa non migana la ume ula lake ga ume tokotarek.”
Pa ugama Iesu aime, “Tenara ga naving labun nung ga namung.”
Tie kakalait it mumurum neip a iriro migana. Ga dusong ga uaro labun ang ga unum ga ula. Uriro la la o sabat.
Pa Iudaiap la amelo iriro migana la mumuri, “Titot la la o sabat. Tale kan mumuru meba naving labun nung ga namung.”
Pa upulo ties maiong gare ro, “Oruluan ties ang iriro migana la tomumuriraong. La toulo gare ro: ‘Narang labun nung ga namung.’”
Pa amarikmeng, “Aga migama la noulo, ‘narang labun nung ga namung?’”
Pa iriro migana la tale kan ait. Muana la mitara papot ma teip ga magaulap na uriro pianam, ga Iesu la ulara.
Tubiat Iesu la agimaong na luguan o lotu ga aulo, “Naptang! Titot la nomumuri ra. Baraba gat okosarnung kirinim ba. Babun noba giginanim ula kakanu leba betieng ira nuo.”
Tie, iriro migana la ula maulo Iudaiap, “Migana la tomumuriraong irie Iesu.”
Are ratmat ga pumaiaro Iudaiap ga man akirarameng Iesu. Muana la akosarong iriro paga na la o sabat.
Pa upulo Iesu, “Mamo ruang la ume ubi busit ga muio puoieng titot. Ga turuo gat la tume ubi.”

Teip mila kakanim onim Israel la mepto uriro ties. Are ratmat ga nameng maset meba menamung Iesu ga aving. Memani, tale orupuaba maimai o la o lotu. Karuk. Pa ugama, Morowa irie Mamo ang migat. Are ratmat ga uriro ties la betieng gare Morowa. Uriro ties la uaramo namo kauna gare Morowa.
Iesu kauna gare Morowa

Tie, Iesu la upulo ties maiong ga ugama, “Mirulo migat Kulot la tale kan puoong meba akosarang paga ba o agat ang kan. Karuk. Makosarong it pagap la magimaong aun Mamo la makosarong. Pagap la ume makosar Mamo, miriet la ume makosar Kulot.
Mamo la naong me Kulot ga asinguala ma mirier pagap la ume makosar. Ga eba asingala Kulot ma noba ubiap mila kakanim la makurupmein iriro paga la amuriraong iro migana. Ga eba man turupmiaba papot.
Eva, iriro la migat. Mamo la ina ume imuam teip ga magaulap la mevara ga ualo ninimiap maun. Are ratmat ga turuo gat Poi ang la eba talang ninimiap maun teip ga magaulap o kan agat tung.
Ga are gat to, Mamo la tale kan ume avuvuo noba migana na ties. Karuk. Uriro ubi ounuptap o ties la ualor toun Poi ang.

Are ratmat ga mirier teip ga magaulap ganam le maiaving bonim tuo Poi ang me nakap, aret tie la mime maiavio bonim a Mamo me nakap. Teip ga magaulap la tale kan mime maiavio bonim tuo Poi ang, are la tale kan mime maiavio bonim a Mamo irie la tosagaong ga muruo.

Mirulo migat. Teip ga magaulap la mepto ties tung ga naganmeng ira Mamo irie la tosagaong ga muruo, memaning ninimiap la iot maset atatan makin. Ga tala gat dusmeng na ties, karuk. Omaiolaira nuvarap ga omela ra ninimiap.
Mirulo migat, tara la namo betang pa titot la betong ara me teip ga magaulap la mevara ra eba meptang nanam tuo Poi ang Morowa. Pa teip ga magaulap la mepto ties tung, eba omela ninimiap.
Mamo kan la muana o ninimiap. Ga ualo kukunim toun Poi ang ga turuo la turuo gat muana o ninimiap.
Turuo gare Migana migat ang Morowa. Are ratmat ga uala ra Mamo kaguma toun meba tabum teip ga magaulap na ties ga avuvuorang tavuk maiang.
Baraba agatming papot ume ties tung. Tara la namo betang me mirier teip ga magaulap ganam la maiot na una, leba meptang nanam tuo.

Tie, teip ga magaulap la akosarmeng tavuk ila muri, eba ina temaiara ga meimung. Pa teip ga magaulap la akosarmeng tavuk ila kire, eba ina temaiara ga dusmeng na ties ga eba tiesmeng gare ro, ‘Eba iouming.’”

“Tale kan puorung meba akosartang paga ba o agat tung it. Karuk. Tume oruluan ties la tuaro aun Mamo ga avuvuo tung tavuk maiang inamaniap ga magaulap. Ga puvuvui ties tung, memani, tale kan tume oruluan agat tung kan. Karuk. Oruluan kan agat ang Mamo, irie la tosagaong ga muruo na uro kimanam.”
Inagat tiesong Iesu gare ro, “Leba baistang me rulam kan, urie bais tung la tale migat o.
Pa non kan la unama ga baisong me rulam. Ga orit uriro ties la baisong me rulam la migat o. Non la unama, irie gat la ume uaramo ubi ga tavuk tuang. Ga orit, uriro ties la uaramo la migat o.”
Bais ang Ioanes
“Tie, tinan la masagaming ga mela ai Ioanes. Ga baisong ara o ties migat.
Pa tale kan tuario bais maiong inamaniap, pa tuaramam miriro tiesiap muana la narung meba ina milagiang Morowa.
Ioanes la are lalabie la ulabie ga uala lalabie maun teip ga magaulap. Ga at tara ila popoi la temeba dalap mi me lalabie ang.

Pa mating non kaguma la okurupin nanam a Ioanes ga misingtuala turuo aga. Miriro ubiap la ualam Mamo toun meba makosartang ga itamum. Miriro ubiap la tume makosar la baismeng maset mai teip ga magaulap gare ro, Mamo la tosagaong ga muruo na kimanam.
Ga irie kan la baisong ara me rulam. Pa tale kan puoming meba miptang ma kigip mi o magimaming ma irap mi.
Ga ties gat ang la tale kan iot miun. Karuk. Muana la tale naganming iro ties tung, la tosagaong Mamo ga muruo.”
Bais ieng babam ula puaru onim tinan
“Man ubiming maranit la man mavasming babap onim tinan la ualo Morowa miun. Memani, man naganming leba omiuluo eba omila ninimiap ula iot atatan makin. Tie, babap am Morowa la mime bais me rulam.
Pa tale iga mumiong toi meba omila ninimiap.
Upien maiong inamaniap la tale kan tume orula.
Pa mirit ubonuvarap ang Morowa la tale kan iot na dalap mi.
Muruo na bonim a Mamo ruang, pa tale kan iga miptang ties tung ga omila. Karuk. Pa leba muong migana ba na bonim a kan, tie eba naming aime ga eba kakalait omila ties ang.

Mimi, teip ga magaulap lare tiro la tale kan puomeng meba naganmeng ira ruo. Karuk kan! Memani, mitara kadikming meba miarang bonim ula kakanu maun garip mim kan. Are ratmat ga tale iga miarang bonim ula kakanu aun Morowa la ume ualo maun teip ga magaulap.
Pa baraba naganming ga mimama eba mitabung na ties ai Mamo. Karuk. Migana la eba miabung na ties, irie Moses. Pa naganming miga Moses la eba miagaalie.
Leba naganming migat ties ang Moses la omirong, tie eba gat naganming ties tung. Memani, tiesiap la mamirong Moses la tiesmeng it me rulam.
Pa mirit ara, tale kan naganming migat iro ties ang Moses, are ratmat ga tala kan naganming iro ties tung gat.”

footnotes.text: Non teip o agat onim Ebraio la naganmeng bonim o uriro kin o burunam Betsaida.

Teip o usingnualap onim Israel la meburio ties gare ro, ‘migana o magabun leba maiaving noba paga na irap ma inamaniap ga namo abung na luguan ang na la o sabat, eba menamung ga aving.’ Non teip o usingnualap la megama, “Leba migana ba leba amumuriraang noba migana na la o sabat, uriro gat la kirinim.
